trainium_feasibility: Exact source SHA256 116188cfb1b9b52ee9bb7222a683c899a32cb26ec7c1e13f1f20b2496229534d previously completed full-chip training on trn21 and passed four-rank CPU G2 on trn22 for historical flags. This file accepts --max-train-seconds at line 1303. The argument changes wall-clock LR, weight-decay and momentum scheduling in Python, which can change optimizer state and losses. Whether model forward/backward compiled graph shapes are unchanged is a source-based hypothesis requiring native graph/cache evidence. The compiler/startup phase may still take minutes because first startup steps have an allowance independent of the 120-second training target. Seven dedicated cache paths are precreated empty under the new root; the documented NEURON_COMPILE_CACHE_URL must point to the fresh persistent directory, with no compiler cache-dir override.
cheapest_falsifier: Verify all fresh cache directories empty and effective persistent-cache routing, then either capture the first Neuron compiler/journal error or observe at least 20 finite synchronized step boundaries on every rank plus normal termination. If effective cold-cache isolation cannot be demonstrated, result is inconclusive as a cold contrast even if startup succeeds.

cache_policy.proof_required: Before launch all seven paths and root are absent, then create private empty cache dirs and record zero object counts. Set documented NEURON_COMPILE_CACHE_URL to cache/persistent. Leave external NEURON_CC_FLAGS unset and verify no inherited --cache_dir override. After first compile, show newly written compiler objects under the declared persistent URL and archive cache/debug logs. Never clear or overwrite any older cache. An empty NEURON_COMPILE_CACHE_DIR alone does not prove true coldness.

trusted_prepare.policy: Copy only exact train.py into the fresh sandbox; import unchanged trusted prepare.py by PYTHONPATH. Verify fresh-process imported prepare.__file__ and SHA before launch.

success_criteria.quality: Not measured; no public20M, no BPB delta, no decide.py win/adoption and no S0 submission clearance.
success_criteria.throughput: Record compile/startup time, startup allowance cap/excess, charged training time and effective cache path; no training-throughput or quality comparison with 1800-second runs.
success_criteria.correctness: All four ranks compile and initialize cleanly, complete at least 20 finite synchronized training steps each, exit normally, produce a finite/loadable model checkpoint if the source writes one, and leave complete logs plus quiescent postflight. Also prove effective cold-cache isolation with new files in the previously empty documented persistent URL. If slow cold compilation consumes the startup allowance and the file cleanly ends before 20 steps, classify INCONCLUSIVE_FOR_CODE_CACHE rather than a 116188 or S0 code defect. Under 20 steps or absent per-rank/cold proof is never a PASS; actual compiler errors are failures and all evidence is retained.

abort_conditions: Any A0 train/eval or Neuron holder still active; disk free <6.5 GiB; STOP/breaker; unique label/root collision; non-empty or unverified cache; source or prepare hash mismatch.
Wrong graph/model flags, source-byte edit, inherited compiler cache override, wrong seed/topology, NaN, crash, checkpoint absence, missing all-rank step evidence or non-quiescent postflight.
Do not rerun a consumed label; archive the first real compiler error and rank journals on failure.
